description: This file defines a class `AnswerWithSelf` that implements Mockito's `Answer` interface to provide custom mock behavior, particularly returning the mock object itself if applicable.

classes.name: AnswerWithSelf
classes.description: A class implementing Mockito's `Answer` to return the mock object itself when appropriate.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides custom answer logic: returns the mock object if the return type is compatible, otherwise delegates to RETURNS_DEFAULTS.
